lines.text: [예제] ROLLUP 함수를 추가한 집계 보고서에서 집계 레코드를 구분할 수 있는 GROUPING 함수가 추가된 SQL 문장이다.

blocks.text:
SELECT  B.DNAME, GROUPING (B.DNAME) AS DNAME_GRP
, A.J0B , GROUPING (A.JOB ) AS J0B_GRP
, COUNT (*) AS EMP_CNT, SUM (A.SAL) AS SAL_SUM
FROM EWP A, DEPT B
WHERE B.DEPTNO = A.DEPTNO
GROUP BY ROLLUP (B.DNAME, A.J0B)
ORDER BY B.DNAME, A.JOB;
